title: EDR_T3 re-level — Phase-1 diagnosis + proposed independent fix (read-only; NO mutation)
bright_line: Leveling derived ONLY from our own markers. P13HMEON reference is the Phase-3 GATE, never a leveling input.

defect_mechanism.tool: USGS AlignmentHelper v1.0.1 (Jenkins & Kupfner Johnson 2024, DOI 10.5066/P9YN4KDX), vendored at vendor/usgs/AlignmentHelper_v1.py
defect_mechanism.how_it_levels: alignButtonClicked sets chunk.transform = S * T_bbox.inv() -> the BOUNDING-BOX rotation defines the level frame INCLUDING roll. refineButtonClicked computes yaw=atan(dY/dX) and pitch=atan(dZ/dX) from the 2-marker MIDLINE and applies euler2mat([yaw, pitch, 0]) only if 'Zero pitch' is checked, else [yaw,0,0]. The 3rd Euler angle (ROLL) is ALWAYS 0.
why_it_failed: Long-axis (+11.92): 'Zero pitch' was NOT applied on day 1 -> the marker midline (14-20) retains a +9.69 pitch in the current frame (confirmed).

Cross-axis (+21.71): a 2-marker midline is a LINE and cannot define roll; refine never corrects roll; roll came only from the operator's visual bbox orientation, which was mis-rolled (hard to judge for a 1 m-wide underwater strip).
residual midline yaw is also -5.94 (not perfectly parallel to X).

marker_vetting.evidence: scale-bar 25_26 = +15.13 mm (+6%), the largest residual by far; AND including 25/26 corrupts the level-plane fit.
marker_vetting.decision: EXCLUDE 25/26 from the level-plane fit. With them, leveling leaves the DEM at 17.23 (FAIL); without them, 2.03 (PASS). Likely shared bad-marker root cause -> FLAG for the EDR_T1 production transect. Do NOT re-detect markers or re-derive scale (scale validated at 10.00 m, must be preserved).

consistency_check.interpretation: The vetted-marker substrate plane normal sits ~22 off current Z (close to the surface's 24) and within ~2 of the DEM normal -> correcting to it should flatten the gated DEM to ~2.

corroborators.note: long-axis ~10-12 is robust across ALL sources; cross-axis is the under-constrained DOF (varies 4-22 by subset), exactly matching the 2-marker roll-blindness.

proposed_fix.method: Fit a least-squares plane to the VETTED 6 markers; compute rotation R that maps that plane normal -> world Z; apply R to chunk.transform (orientation only). This is the data-driven generalization of the AlignmentHelper method (a plane from >=3 fiducials defines all 3 axes, fixing the roll DOF the 2-marker midline cannot).
proposed_fix.preserve: transform.scale unchanged (10.00 m); NO re-align / optimize / marker-detect / dense; region reset to 10x1x5 m in the new frame so the pipeline tripwire + extent stay correct.
proposed_fix.expected_result: DEM residual tilt ~2.0 (within the <=2-3 gate); scale 10.00 m; co-reg dx=dy=0; detrended roughness ~0.10 m ~= raw (tilt removed).
proposed_fix.caveats: marker Y-spread is only 0.85 m (1 m transect) -> the cross-axis estimate has limited precision; ~2 is an estimate. Phase-3 reference comparison (GATE) will confirm.
proposed_fix.headless_vs_gui: HEADLESS programmatic re-level (reproducible, data-driven roll). GUI AlignmentHelper fallback available but NOT preferred: its roll relies on error-prone visual bbox judgment (the day-1 failure mode).
